questions.text: What are the persistent entity types (such as users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications) defined in the persistence layer schema?
What are the cardinalities and foreign key relationships connecting reports to locations, categories, users, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications?
Which specific data fields and attributes of each persistent entity must be preserved across the entire lifecycle of a municipal report?
Which application modules, services, or queries directly depend on the database tables and schemas storing municipal report data and its related entities?
How are state transition logs and internal notes linked to reports to ensure auditability and data integrity throughout the report lifecycle?
